method_limits: Transcriptions are AI visual readings of page images; an independent reviewer must confirm them before any status promotion.
Long printed condition paragraphs of Appendix I forms are recorded as incipits (INCIPIT_ONLY) with every blank itemised; full wording remains on the page image.
R04 comparison uses normalised whole-phrase containment and a best-window token ratio; it locates differences, it does not judge their legal effect.
bbox values are approximate fractions read by eye.
Navy Regulations Part II Appendix I forms are registered from the list page only; their fields were not transcribed this cycle.

transcription_conventions: Blanks: every dotted or open blank that stands alone or ends a line is a separate 'blank' row; blanks embedded inside a printed sentence (e.g. 'I ...... do solemnly declare', 'The Superintendent ..... of') are NOT itemised and the sentence is recorded as one row (applied as found by review F05; not retro-itemised).
Misprints: kept as printed (e.g. 'regmient', 'Prision', 'togethe', 'PRAT III', 'whcih', 'Reseve', 'Service or years').

Degraded glyphs: where the letter shapes are broken but the word is unambiguous from the remaining glyphs on the same image, the word is typed normally and listed in DEGRADED_GLYPH_NORMALISATIONS; where it is not unambiguous, it is written [illegible].

version_evidence.text: S.R.O. 116 (New Delhi, 27th March 1965), Army (1st Amendment) Rules, 1965, r.2(b): in Appendix I, Form No. I—COMBATANTS, (i) under 'Enrolment for Army Service and Reserve Service', last paragraph, the words from 'by the competent authority, that is to say, if you are of the rank of havildar ...' to '... in Army Rule 13 (or higher authority)' are substituted by 'by the Commanding Officer as defined in Army Rule 13, but if you are of the rank of havildar (or equivalent rank) and the Commanding Officer is below the rank of Lieutenant Colonel, then, by the Officer Commanding the Brigade, or higher authority'; (ii) a corresponding substitution under 'Enrolment for Army Service only, transfer to the Reserve where such exists being voluntary'.
